metadata.title: World population by country
metadata.definition: Total population based on the de facto definition, counting all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship.
notes: Aggregate regions and income groups were excluded; country and territory economies provided by the World Bank are included.
A null value means the World Bank has no observation for that economy and year in the retrieved dataset.
